WYNN-STRUCTURE|2026-09-02.adjudication:
PRE-REGISTERED DECISION for the WYNN call-spread complex — written 2026-08-17 with WYNN at $102.23, BEFORE the event, precisely so it is not decided in the moment (catalyst->action doctrine; the BKE miss was the trigger for that rule). POSITION: Oct16 105/115 x12 (cost $3,848, max $12,000 — the leg that decides the outcome), Nov20 105/120 x3, Jun-27 110/140 x3. Total cost $7,725, max $25,500. At $102.23 the Oct spread needs +5.8% to break even and +12.5% for max; market-implied odds are ~41% to touch intrinsic, ~32% to break even, ~17% to max.

THE TWO-BY-TWO IS THE WHOLE POINT. Grade the PRINT and the TAPE SEPARATELY, then act on the pair — the failure mode this pack exists to prevent is reading a favorable print with a flat tape as 'thesis working, be patient' when it is actually 'thesis right, EXPRESSION wrong'.

The frozen call is MACAU-GGR|2026-09-01 our_p 0.72 that August YoY > +1.3%. FROZEN MEANS FROZEN — grade it, never re-strike it, whatever the tape does.

branches.PRINT FAVORABLE (>+1.3%) AND WYNN >= ~$1: The thesis AND the expression are working. HOLD all three tranches to expiry — do NOT take profits into the move; the Oct spread's whole payoff is convex above 105 and 6 weeks of tenor remain. Re-read only if the Sept 20-25 arrivals data (MACAU-SPV) shows the beat was tourism-VOLUME driven rather than the premium wallet returning, which is the thesis's actual signature.
branches.PRINT FAVORABLE (>+1.3%) AND WYNN FLAT-T: THE DECISIVE BRANCH, and the pre-registered ruling is: the THESIS was right and the EXPRESSION was wrong. A monthly GGR print historically moves these names 1-4%, not the +5.8% the Oct spread needs; if our best-odds catalyst lands and the tape shrugs, no remaining catalyst inside the Oct tenor is larger (Q3 prints 11/05, AFTER expiry, by design). Ruling: treat the Oct tranche as DEAD MONEY and write that verdict into the calibration record as an EXPRESSION failure, not a thesis failure — the distinction is the lesson. Do NOT roll, do NOT double, do NOT average the strike down: rolling a spread that just failed its own catalyst is paying twice for the same idea. Hold to expiry only because exit friction is ~23% of mark on a 125-contract open-interest line (selling is worth ~$2.17 against a ~$2.81 mid) — i.e. hold by LIQUIDITY DEFAULT, not by conviction, and say so. The Nov and Jun-27 tranches survive on their own dated legs (Q3 hold-reversion test; UAE 2027).
branches.PRINT UNFAVORABLE (<= +1.3%): The frozen 0.72 grades a MISS and the wallet-substitution-reversal mechanism takes real damage. The Oct tranche is written off (hold to expiry on the same liquidity-default logic — there is nothing to salvage at a ~20% bid-ask). MATERIAL CONSEQUENCE BEYOND THIS POSITION: kill the World-Cup-diversion excuse in every Macau record, and the cohort courts (Galaxy/Sands/1128.HK) must re-price DEMAND risk rather than share dispersion. Grade the mechanism, not just the trade.
branches.TYPHOON / WEATHER CONTAMINATION: If a signal-8+ storm closed floors or bridges during August, the LEVEL read is contaminated: grade primarily on the Sept 20-25 spend-per-visitor leg (arrivals absorb the weather shock) and annotate the 09-01 grade as weather-confounded. Do not let a contaminated miss kill the mechanism.
branches.PRINT SLIPS OR IS AMBIGUOUS: DICJ cadence is statutory; a genuine slip is near-impossible. If the number is ambiguous (revisions, definitional change), annotate and grade on the published headline — never re-strike our_p.
